'''Zarra''' was the name of [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] used by a [[Unidentified Rebel sergeant (Zarra)|sergeant]] serving with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] had not informed anyone of [[Gender/Legends|his]] reason for choosing "Zarra" as the name of his rifle.

==Description==
Zarra was a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] with a small [[targeting scope]] and a long [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] with holes running down its length. While the most of the barrel was [[Color/Legends|silver-colored]], the coloration of the gun gradually changed to black near the trigger and dark gray on the [[Stock/Legends|stock]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized [[Species/Legends|species]] needed two [[Limb/Legends|hands]] to wield Zarra effectively.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

==History==
A Human [[Unidentified Rebel sergeant (Zarra)|sergeant]] who served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] gave [[Gender/Legends|his]] rifle the name "Zarra" many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. At some point following the battle, the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] still carried the rifle, but he had not told anyone the origins of his weapon's name.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rifle known as Zarra was featured in [[2008]]'s [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']], the first set of [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'', a virtual card game created to go along with<ref name="ChampionsSet">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]]&mdash;[[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']]</ref> the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The card game was shut down at the same time as ''Star Wars Galaxies'',<ref name="SWGTCG" /> which was closed on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zarra was created for the Rebel Sergeant card, which was illustrated by the artist [[Svetlin Velinov]]. While the card did not specify what model of rifle Zarra was, the weapon was similar in appearance to<ref name="SWGTCG" /> the [[E-17d sniper rifle/Legends|E-17d sniper rifle]],<ref name="Battlefront II Guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> the [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A blaster rifle]], and the [[Pulse cannon/Legends|pulse cannon]].<ref name="TCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
